_readme: Copy this file to config.json and edit vault_path. That one line is the only thing you MUST change.
The API key does NOT live here -- it is read from the INTERVIEW_ASSISTANT_GEMINI_KEY environment variable.
setx INTERVIEW_ASSISTANT_GEMINI_KEY "your-key-here"   (then open a NEW terminal)
Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey . Use a project of its OWN so this app's spend is visible and capped separately.
Keys beginning with _ are ignored by the app, so you can leave notes to yourself here.

interview._vault_path: REQUIRED. The folder of .md notes to answer from -- an Obsidian vault or any tree of markdown. Forward slashes work on Windows.
interview._models: Defaults measured Aug 2026: flash-lite is both the cheapest and the fastest tier. Do NOT use the retired gemini-2.5-* family; it 404s on projects created after mid-2026.
interview._retrieval: min_score is the grounding threshold: raise toward 0.72 to refuse more often, lower if it declines on topics you HAVE written up. adjacent_margin is the band just below it that gets an honest bridging answer instead of a flat refusal.
interview._tiers: How you actually know each folder's content, which caps how much experience an answer may claim. Keys are folder names (deepest match wins, case-insensitive); a note's own frontmatter 'tier:' overrides the map. Order: production > project > study > reference. Delete this whole block to turn tier gating off.
interview._vault_exclude: Folder names dropped from the index entirely (any path segment, case-insensitive).
interview._tier_ceiling_margin: 0.0 = only the single best-matching note decides how much experience an answer may claim. Raise it slightly (0.02 worked on a 24k-chunk vault) if your own notes keep losing narrowly to course notes on the same topic: a higher-tier note scoring within this distance of the top then counts, but only if its title or headings name what was asked. Measure before raising it further.
interview._server: port is the localhost port for --serve.
interview._index_path: Optional. Give a config its own index file so switching this config to a different vault cannot overwrite the other vault's index -- the vector cache lives inside that file, so losing it means paying for a full re-embed. Default: interview_index.json
interview._listening: Windows-only loopback capture (needs the 'soundcard' package). silence_threshold is an RMS level and may need tuning to your system volume. Set hangover LONG (2000-2500) so a thinking pause cannot split one question in two -- responsiveness comes from partial_tail_flush_ms, not from this.
interview._stt_cost: Transcription is the only cost that accrues while nobody is asking anything: audio left playing with listening on bills continuously. These two caps stop that. 0 disables either one.
interview._screen: Reading a question off the page. Launch the browser with start-interview-chrome.bat or start-interview-firefox.bat -- both use port 9223. screen_url_hint only ever BREAKS TIES between visible tabs; a focused, visible tab always wins first.
interview._jd: Where the pasted job description is saved. It steers WHICH of your real experiences lead; it never licenses a fact that is not in your notes.
